senses.gloss: m. (Syr. בוקלא; בכן, בקל √בך, בק to split; cmp. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. בכא)
a club, a stripped smooth pole, bar.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 102a:10">Erub. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ קאמרת</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <cite ref="B00793"><he>בכנא</he></cite>) you speak of a club (with a handle used as a door-bar).—Pl. <he>בּוּכָאנֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 93b:9">B. Kam. 93ᵇ</cite> it says (in the Mish.), ‘If one robbed pieces of wood and made utensils out of them’ <he>בב׳ דהיינו וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ב׳</he> with one <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>, Ms. H. <he>בביכאני</he>) it means that he made them into clubs, that is ‘he polished them’.

senses.gloss: esp. a club (with handles) used as a pestle for crushing olives &c.
units: Sabb. 77ᵇ (playful etymology) בוכנא ב̇ו̇א ואכ̇נה (Ar. it is called bukhana, ‘come and I shall strike’.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:6:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ובוכנה דו כתת ביה</he> and concerning a club, for he pounds with it; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 17:2:3">Y. Sabb. XVII, 16ᵇ</cite> top <he>במכונה</he> (read <he>בבוכנה</he>).
<cite ref="Niddah 36b:73">Nidd. 36ᵇ I</cite> am <he>ב׳ דפרזלא וכ׳</he> an iron pestle which breaks the copper mortar.
Bets. 14ᵃ בו׳ (Ar. ed. Koh. בכ׳).—Trnsf. the rib resting in the pelvis, hip-joint.
